edgeReentry.description: 2459 stays size-eligible and LOS-visible; higher-priority 2404 takes its slot at frame 28 and leaves at 32. The label briefly returns before its own text exits at 34. Full entry clearance at viewport edges prevents the return.

paddingOnlyHandoff.description: After the edge fix, 356 loses padded placement ownership for one frame to 389. Painted text does not intersect. Using padded placement boxes to suppress visible fades destroyed the old state. Separating painted bounds preserves the fade and DOM identity.

fadeCompletionFalsePositive.description: After both renderer fixes, full-sampling 15904 begins departure at 290km, finishes fading around 420km, then returns around 485km. Ownership change is 1.67x; measuring only after fade completion reports 1.15x. Acceptance retains the 1.25x threshold but starts at ownership loss. Opacity-only blinks still fail.
